mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.1% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates and increasing equity valuations, producing positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window, or 5-day returns in FEDFUNDS < 0.1% periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rates exceeding 8.5% signal deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, causing negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 8.5% over 3-year rolling windows, or Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) above 90% of 5-year moving averages indicate robust economic expansion, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: The joint GDPC1 and HOUST signal above 90% of 5-year average fails to yield positive returns in > 50% of cases over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Consumer price inflation exceeding 225 (CPIAUCSL) indicates an inflationary environment, prompting central bank rate hikes that reduce equity valuations and cause negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 225 over 3-year rolling windows, or Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 95 (INDPRO) indicates strong manufacturing output, supporting corporate profit growth and generating positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO's 20-day return correlation drops below 0.05 in any 2-year rolling window, or returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO > 95 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Payroll employment growth exceeding 130,000 (PAYEMS) signals strong labor market conditions, increasing consumer income and driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 50% of instances when PAYEMS > 130000 over 3-year rolling windows, or Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in consumer credit (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) above 90% of 5-year moving averages indicates strong household spending momentum, fueling positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: The joint RSAFS and HOUST signal above 90% of 5-year average fails to produce positive returns in > 50% of cases over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary easing cycles (FEDFUNDS < 0.1%) stimulate investment and consumption, generating positive 60-day S&P 500 returns through sustained low discount rates.
failure_condition: 60-day SPX returns are negative in > 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.1% over 3-year rolling windows, or Rank IC < 0.01.
